content: Ka wahuma nihenina kadu aitam iaiaya pai nua‑tupatupa ani‑vainena adueyei, vivane anelose ai yau 7, ka taui wayahia vita pai nau‑yehata ai yau 7. Vitaia vivane pai nau‑yehata, iuna avi tuta vitaia ina‑iakwa, akanai dewa‑yaiyai habuhabui Yaubada ya nua‑goyo wayahina ivinꞌ‑omo kadu ina‑iakwa.

Ka aitam amane adueyei ana dune navu gelasi kadu ai ananata ainua nau‑tamoia tupwana deina. Ka navu‑nana awaniana tomotau imimini‑vivinei. Tomotau‑naia taui vahitau simai‑nana ivane‑tawanei, ka tauna ya itupwanana ivane‑tawanei, ka kadu tauna ana wava a pai ainana iginumina ivane‑tawanei. Ka Yaubada pai viam‑toutou venei taui nimaia ivo‑vi‑avini,
e habuhabui Yaubada ya tau paisewa ana wava Mosese yanꞌ ahe iaheahei, ka kadu aitam ahe Lami‑nanaV wayahina iaheahei, ivona,
“Kauvea Yaubada Tau Bagibagi‑vainem, wamke yam dewa ani‑vainena kadu pai nua‑tupatupa! Ka yam dewa habuhabuna ahiahina kadu tunutunuhina, wamke Tuta Habuhabuna ana KiniV.

Koiaka ana pata wamke, O Kauvea, wayahim na‑vona, ‘Yauke eha amatauta Yaubada wayahina.’? Eha aitam! Akanai habuhabui am wava ivo‑vi‑natei! Iuna wamke am heta ahihimata. Wayahina, tomotau papani habuhabui wayahina nau‑wawani inꞌ‑omo wamke tepama, e tauma ina‑iwaodu. Iuna wamke avaha yam dewa tunutunuhina esi‑vinꞌ‑omanei kadueyei.”
Ka dewaia tanoi iakwa, e adunedune, e Manua Vito‑pota wahuma nihenina adueyei, e Yaubada Yanꞌ Awaeha ana Ine am‑waei.

Ka Manua Vito‑pota‑nana wayahina anelose‑naia ai yau 7 na vitai pai nau‑yehata iomo. Taui ai kwama aitam kaleko ana wava lineniV, ka kwama‑naia hadahadanina kadu vo‑vi‑namanamanina, babau deina, ka kadu manakadai awaniaia haiona goulaV iweteweteni.
Ka aitam vahitau yawayawai na nau‑punina wayahia anelose‑naia ai yau 7 gaeba goulaV ai yau 7 vene‑neiei. Ka dewa‑yaiyai Yaubada Tau Maꞌ‑vavaha ya nua‑goyo wayahina gaeba‑naia nau‑vi‑anai.

Ka Yaubada didigana kadu ya bagibagi Manua Vito‑pota‑nana vi‑nau‑vi‑anai, bawa deina. Ka eha aitam koiaka ana pata Manua Vito‑pota‑nana na‑nu a itoava vitaia ai yau 7 pai nau‑yehata anelose‑naia ai yau 7 wayahia ina‑iakwa wayahina.
